summary: Iteration 41: frontend-only test of the 'BIBLIA – Color Update' (theme tokens, profile level card, library cover overlay). Tested at 390x844 in LIGHT and DARK (emulated prefers-color-scheme). Method: (a) a static WCAG check of 34 token pairs per mode (iter41_contrast.py); (b) an in-page audit that computes contrast for every visible text node against its blended background (iter41_contrast_audit.js); (c) reading computed styles for selected/unselected states. Screens: home atlas, Studienreise, Bible reader with verse sheet, highlights and selected verse, tab bar, library, lexicon list and article, station john-1 (tasks, selected/correct/wrong answers, primary buttons), Mein geistlicher Weg register chips, settings, profile level card. RESULT: all theme-token text passes AA in both modes. Body text is 15.7:1. Muted text is 4.70–5.86:1 (light) and 5.43–7.22:1 (dark). The primary button label is 8.80:1 (light) and 7.42:1 (dark). Brand-coloured text and links are ≥6.67:1. Semantic on-colours are ≥5.09:1. The real-DOM audit found no theme-driven text below AA on any screen. Every flag it raised was a false positive (text over an image or gradient) or a pre-existing hard-coded data colour. Selected and unselected states are clearly distinct: selected chips are Deep Ink/Parchment inverse; the lexicon sort and task 'selected' use a green border plus a gold tint; the active tab has an onSurface label plus a brandTertiary pill, the inactive tab a muted label. The profile level card is a gold→orange gradient with #101A1C text (6.82/5.60:1) in both modes. The intro and the welcome modal are unchanged: only literal colours, the files are not modified, and screenshots look identical in light and dark. No layout or function changes: git diff shows only colour values in theme.ts, profile.tsx, library.tsx and design_guidelines.json. Navigation (tabs, deep links, back buttons, station phases, answer check) works, with no page errors. FAILURES (WCAG): (1) Input and chip borders use the `border` token, which is 1.47:1 (light) and 1.45–1.61:1 (dark). This is below 3:1 for UI component boundaries. (2) `warning` (#D4A352) is used as TEXT colour in light mode at 2.04:1. Both are pre-existing patterns, not introduced by this update, but the request explicitly asked for ≥3:1 and ≥4.5:1. No deprecated Expo packages were found.

ui_bugs.issue: colors.warning #D4A352 used as text on surface #F6F1E7 / surfaceSecondary #ECE5D8 = 2.04 / 1.83:1 (needs 4.5:1). Affected: map route certainty tag ('HYPOTHESE – nicht historisch gesichert', 11px) at app/(tabs)/index.tsx:230 (used lines 147, 196); StudyUI warn text at src/components/StudyUI.tsx:31; the 'Verszählung kann abweichen' meta text at src/components/VerseStudy.tsx:127. In dark mode the same is 7.72:1 (OK). Found by code review; not reproduced in the browser because the route tag needs a world-map route open.

All 15 TextInput wrappers (search fields, note/tag/link inputs) use borderColor c.border. Light #D3C8B3 on #F6F1E7 = 1.47:1; dark #2E3F43 on #101A1C/#182427 = 1.61/1.45:1. That is below WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1). The input fill differs from surface by only 1.11:1, so the field outline is faint. borderStrong passes (3.75/3.37 light, 3.91/3.51 dark).

issues: The active tab pill is only 1.15:1 (light E6D5B5 vs ECE5D8) and 1.24:1 (dark 3A3122 vs 182427) against the bar. The active state is still clear because the label/icon colour changes (onSurface vs muted: 14.1 vs 5.3 light, 14.1 vs 6.5 dark). Acceptable; optional: make the active label/icon brandPrimary for a stronger cue.

The dark-mode brandTertiary #3A3122 (warm brown) is the only leftover brown surface. It is used for the active tab, the selected task option tint and the selected-verse tint. It reads as dark gold and fits, but is not one of the six palette colours.

Correct and wrong are shown mainly by border hue: success #4F6E4A at 4.09:1 vs error #A34A3E at 4.03:1 (light). The two have similar lightness, which is weak for colour-blind users. The feedback box adds an icon and text, so this is not blocking. Pre-existing logic; colours only changed.
The gold→orange level card is a very bright block on the Deep Ink background. It is readable (6.82/5.60:1) but much louder than the rest of the dark UI. Acceptable per the request.

design_issues.screen: Mein geistlicher Weg header (pre-existing data literal)
issues: BOOK_THEMES.way cover/ink gives #FBF3E4 on #807159 = 4.30:1. The 13px subtitle at app/way/index.tsx:35 is just below 4.5:1. The colours are hard-coded data; this did not change with this update.

action_items: MEDIUM (colour-only fix): Add a darker light-mode text variant for warning, e.g. a `warningText` token (#8A5F14 ≈ 5.6:1 on F6F1E7; dark mode keeps #D4A352). Use it for text in index.tsx:230 routeTag, StudyUI.tsx:31 warn and VerseStudy.tsx:127. Keep #D4A352 for icons, borders and fills.

MEDIUM (colour-only fix): Make input outlines reach ≥3:1. Either switch the TextInput wrappers' borderColor from c.border to c.borderStrong, or darken the `border` token (light ≈ #8F8470, dark ≈ #5E7275). Note that changing `border` also makes every card border stronger.
OPTIONAL: Make the selected chip/tab cue less reliant on the low-contrast pill (e.g. tabBarActiveTintColor = brandPrimary).
OPTIONAL: way header subtitle (BOOK_THEMES.way) is 4.30:1. Darken the cover slightly if strict AA is wanted.
critical_code_review_comments: Every onBrandPrimary usage (39) sits on a brandPrimary background. No onBrandPrimary was found on a gold or other background that would break now that it is light in light mode.

No leftover old-palette literals (#2C2822, #C28E3A as UI text, #F9F3E8) remain in screens or components. The remaining #C28E3A/#D9A54E are data colours (highlight 'god', category palette, worlds, timeline, theme maps), which is intentional.
The old gold highlight (rgba(194,142,58,0.2)) under verse text: the text stays #101A1C, so readability is fine.
The intro (IntroAnimation, IntroJourney) and the welcome modal in app/_layout.tsx use only literals and are unchanged.
The NativeTabs (iOS) tintColor=brandPrimary: #1F4A43 (light) and #6DB5A5 (dark), both fine on system bars.

success_rate.frontend: ~92%: every requested screen renders in both modes and all text tokens pass AA; 2 WCAG gaps (input borders, warning text in light mode), both pre-existing patterns

seed_data_creation: Browser-localStorage only (per Playwright context): highlight 'christ' on Joh 1,3, highlight 'grace' on Joh 1,5, one wrong answer in station john-1. No server data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use page.emulate_media(color_scheme='dark'|'light') before goto; the theme follows the system scheme (settings theme-system is the default).
